Winners Deck List:

Deck Name: AUS Nosset
Author: Aapo Järvelin
Description: I wanted to build a deck that can deal most of its damage without any Directed actions. I also like some reactions, so baali based vote was off the table. First built as a fun deck, surprised me at some test games and performed well in the tournament. The deck is quite strong in the late game and can sway the table to your favor with a couple of well placed Parity Shifts and some table talk.

Warsaw station is the most important card in the deck. Might want to add fourth. Telepathic Vote Counting is bad, replace those with something else. Maybe Cryptic Rider and one more political action?

Messages.Author: Khormag
Messages.Body:
Archon is now submitted and approved. Sorry for it taking so long.

There was a conflict situation during the tournament, which required help of the Ethics Committee due to its severity and because we didn't manage to handle the situation perfectly during the tournament.

The situation involved two players and escalated quickly from a heated argument to a quick brawl. Situation calmed down very quickly, and because of it being such a shock and the quick de-escalation of the situation, there was no sanctions given during the tournament.

Prince of Joensuu, Finland

Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
